Lessons.Title: Subtract Fractions Flexibly
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will subtract fractions, including mixed numbers, by decomposing numbers and writing equivalent fractions, and to recognize when these strategies are useful for finding differences.
Key idea: Mixed-number fraction subtraction may require regrouping a whole into denominator-sized parts.
How to reason: Rewrite whole/fraction components with matching denominators; regroup as needed before subtracting.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Which One Doesn’t Belong: Fractional Values (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Wikimedia Commons., \(9\frac{4}{8}\), \(\frac{7}{8}\), \(5\frac{1}{8}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: Multiple Ways to Subtract (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(9\frac{4}{8} - \frac{7}{8}\), \(9\frac{4}{8} - 5\frac{1}{8}\), \(9\frac{4}{8} - 3\frac{5}{8}\), \(5\frac{1}{8} - 3\frac{5}{8}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
Edulytics worked model: A bracelet should measure 9 and 4/8 inches, with 7/8 left. How long is it now?. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
